CheckTitle: Ensure Uploaded Files Are Scanned for Viruses and Restricted by Extension Policy
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: EPM Cloud access (EPM Automate, Service Administrator)
Description: EPM pre-upload virus scanning (setVirusScanOnFileUploads) should be on, and risky file extensions blocked.
Risk: Uploads are a path for malware and scripts into the environment.
AuditProcedure: 'epmautomate getVirusScanOnFileUploads' returns true; an EICAR test upload is rejected; extension exceptions are documented.

Steps: Run 'epmautomate setVirusScanOnFileUploads true', define an extension policy and test.
